subject: [AMBER] RMSD (non mass-weighted) as collective variable in Amber-18

messages.author: Madhur Aggarwal
messages.body:
Hi all,
I want to perform Umbrella Sampling simulations using Root Mean Square Deviation (RMSD) as a collective variable. I wanted to know whether it is possible to use normal, non-mass-weighted RMSD as a collective variable in Amber-18 since I only found Multi-RMSD (mass-weighted RMSD) mentioned in the docs.
Thanks and regards,
Madhur Aggarwal
IIIT Hyderabad
